delta.note: conditional-scenario input ONLY: delta WC(gamma) = gamma * this delta, annual capital effect = delta WC * k_annual -- gamma and k_annual are explicit assumptions in docs/business_case.md, never applied here. One-off working-capital release and annual flows are never summed. Units: M5 sale-price USD, 10-bundle subset; identity: daily holding cost = rho * sum_i p_i * I_i (h_i = rho * p_i, EOD on-hand basis, in-transit excluded).
